'''{{PAGENAME}}s''' are aggressive [[creatures]] found within [[Infested Mine]]s in the [[Mistlands]].

Seekers are large insect-like creatures with traits similar to beetles, ants, and bees. Seeker broods resemble a miniature version of the ordinary [[Seeker]]s, though with a softer yellow carapace. As they are only found within well-protected Seeker nests within Infested Mines, they appear to be Seeker young and not a separate caste.

== Drops ==
{{drop table|
{{drop row|item=Royal jelly|0star=50%}}|stars=0}}

}}

== Attacks and abilities ==
{{For|strategies for defeating Seekers Broods|Aggressive creature strategies#Seeker brood}}

=== Attack ===
Leans back before sweeping downward to clamp the player with their pincers (60 [[Damage types#Pierce|Pierce]] damage). This creates a 1.7-meter 45-degree horizontal arc and can be used every 3 seconds when within 1.5 meters of a player.

== Trivia ==
* For Seeker eggs, the 50% chance is checked separately for stepping and destroying, This results in 75% spawn chance when trying to step on them first.
* Real-life insects like ants and bees emerge from their pupal stage as fully grown adults.
* Seeker hives produce Royal Jelly, which in real life is produced by worker bees and fed to larvae, particularly to produce new queens. Because of this, it can be presumed that the Royal Jelly that Broods drop was eaten by them, not produced by them.

It has two variations: a regular swing and delayed swingThe timing difference between the regular swing and the delayed swing is approximately 0.297 seconds.. === Rage attack (Thungr) === Slams his club into the ground 3 times extending out 4 meters and arcing 60 degrees vertically, stepping forward with each swing (130 [[Damage types#Blunt|Blunt]], 100 Tier 2 [[Damage types#Chop|Chop]] and 40 Tier 2 [[Damage types#Pickaxe|Pickaxe]] damage each). This attack has a 12-second cooldown and can be used when within 20 meters of a player. The fireball travels at 15 meters per second for up to 4 seconds before despawning. It has a spread of 4–20 degrees from the center of his aim. === Protect (Zil) === Casts a protective barrier over all allies within a 6-meter radius, negating up to 100 damage before breaking or lasting for up to 40 seconds. This ability has a 40-second cooldown and can be used within 60 meters of a player. When Thungr is killed, Zil is left alone and his attack pool is reverted to that of a regular [[Fuling Shaman]]. == Drops == {{drop table| {{drop row|item=Hildir's bronze chest|0star=1}} {{drop row|creature=Zil|item=Zil trophy|0star=100%}} {{drop row|creature=Thungr|item=Thungr trophy|0star=100%}} |stars=0}} == Notes == * Zil & Thungr are the first creatures in ''Valheim'' that work as a duo. * Even though they are supposed to be fought as a duo, players can spawn them separately thanks to their Internal IDs. ** Zil's Internal ID is ''GoblinShaman_Hildir'' ** Thungr's Internal ID is ''GoblinBrute_Hildir'' * Zil is the one that drops [[Hildir's bronze chest]]. == Trivia == * According to their trophy descriptions, Zil is older than Thungr, despite the former's size being smaller than the latter. * Zil & Thungr have an envy of each other. Zil is jealous of Thungr's strength, and Thungr is jealous of Zil's magical power. * Zil can still cast his elemental attacks while swimming. * When spawning Thungr with cheats, his corpse is the normal green, instead of blue. * Summoned starred variants of Thungr are brown, where as Zil's stay true to his normal color. == Gallery == #Name of Image.jpg|#Description of image here {{Creatures}} [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Minibosses]] [[de:Zil & Thungr]] [[ru:Зил и Тангр]] [[uk:Зіл і Танґр]]

'''Hive''' is a [[Creatures|boss]] resembling a retextured, upgraded version of [[Bonemass]]. It can only be spawned via [[Developer console|Console Commands]]. 

Hive deals [[Damage#Spirit|Spirit damage]] instead of [[Damage#Poison|Poison damage]] with its attacks, spawns [[Mistlands]]-related minions, and drops items similar to what [[The Queen]] drops. It could be an incomplete placeholder boss for the Mistlands, which was eventually replaced with [[The Queen]].

== Attacks and abilities ==

=== Melee ===
A close-range swipe at a player.

=== Area of Effect ===
Hive will charge up with a thick green cloud before releasing a wave of ooze. This is signaled when he leans backwards.

=== Spawn ===
At intervals, Hive will reach into his armpit to throw out a glob of goop. This is never directed at a player, and will spawn up to four random monsters ( [[Seeker|Seekers]] and/or [[Tick|Ticks]]) where it lands. No more of a creature type will be spawned once eight of that type are already present.

=== Ranged ===
A ranged attack (it is unclear what it looks like in action). It has a 30 meter range. [[Bonemass]] does not have an analogue to this attack.

== Notes ==
* Despite visually resembling a red Bonemass, Hive is probably an unused [[The Queen|Mistlands Boss]] since its spawns and drops are Mistlands creatures/items.

'''Lord Reto''' is a [[Creatures|miniboss]] found in the [[Ashlands]]. He is part of the sub-quest to craft the [[Dyrnwyn]].

He can be found inside the dungeon [[Tomb of Lord Reto]]. The location of the dungeon is given by following a series of 3 [[Vegvisir]]s, see [[Mysterious Location]] for details.

== Attacks and abilities ==
{{For|strategies for defeating Lord Reto|Boss strategies#Lord Reto}}
Lord Reto spawns naturally with 2 stars, so all of his stats are listed with those [[Creature Level#Effects|multipliers]] taken into account. He has an attack move set similar to a regular [[Charred Warrior]], but more health and damage than even a 2-starred Charred Warrior. He is also capable of killing a player in one-hit, even if they have got the currently max health and [[Flametal Armor|best armor]] possible. ([[Piquant Pie]], [[Mashed Meat]] and [[Fiery Svinstew]] which provides 300 health.)

=== Swing ===
A vertical sword slash that creates a 3-meter 115-degree arc in front (480 [[Damage types#Slash|Slash]] damage). It can be used every 3 seconds when within 1.6 meters of a player.

=== Thrust ===
A forward stab that extends in a 3-meter line which arcs slightly by 10 degrees (460 [[Damage types#Pierce|Pierce]] damage). This attack can be used every 3 seconds when within 1.6 meters of a player.

=== Feint ===
Shares the same windup as the swing, but Lord Reto will suddenly pause before shifting stances to attack with a different slash that hits in a 3-meter 77.3-degree vertical arc (500 [[Damage types#Slash|Slash]] damage). It can be used every 8 seconds when within 1.6 meters of a player. There is practically no difference between the animation for this attack and that of the regular swing<ref group="Note">The timing difference between the regular swing and the feint is approximately 0.57 seconds.</ref>; there is more than enough time to react and parry again, but the attack will catch rolling players unless completely moving out of his range.

=== Thrust feint ===
Shares the same windup as the thrust, but Lord Reto will suddenly pause before attacking with an upward swing from his current stance (420 [[Damage types#Pierce|Pierce]] damage). This attack creates a vertical arc that is 3 meters long and spans 60 degrees. It can be used every 3 seconds when within 1.6 meters of a player. Similar to the regular feint, there is practically no difference between the animation for this attack and that of the regular thrust<ref group="Note">The timing difference between the thrust and the feint thrust is approximately 0.631 seconds.</ref>; there is more than enough time to react and parry again, but the attack will catch rolling players unless completely moving out of his range.

'''Fryslings''' are hostile [[Deep North]] creatures that attack from range by throwing snowballs. They drop [[Frostcore]]s, but in the current game version no location or dungeon places Frysling spawners, so they do not appear in normal play; Frostcores are instead found hanging in the [[Winding Tunnels]].

Fryslings tolerate water, fire and smoke. They are staggered when their attack is blocked.

== Drops ==
{{drop table|
{{drop row|item=Frostcore|0star=1}}
|stars=0}}
The number of Frostcores dropped increases with star level.

== Attacks and abilities ==
* '''Snowball''': a projectile dealing 50 [[Damage types#Blunt|Blunt]] and 100 [[Damage types#Frost|Frost]] damage. Fryslings use it at targets within 10 meters, at most once every three seconds.

Fryslings notice targets within 30 meters and also attack player-built structures. If hurt while unable to reach their target, they flee.
